title: Vector Wave
author: Silent Pixel
summary: Drop-in, pick-up powerful weapons and blast your friends into the void in this 2.5D party platform shooter, where the bullets don’t hurt, but the knockback does!
note: The currently accessible demo is the old Unity version. Zig version coming soon!

title: Native Video
author: Clay Tercek
summary: Native Video provides hardware-accelerated MP4 playback for H.264 and HEVC.
details: It uses the operating system decoder and works with Godot's stock VideoStreamPlayer.

title: Hap Video
author: Clay Tercek
summary: Hap Video plays Hap-encoded QuickTime and MOV files with GPU-native decoding.
details: It targets installations, live visuals, and projects that need several high-resolution video layers at once.
